digest.component_or_area: plan-review-health integration across detailed inspection surfaces
propositions: Operators cannot currently understand pin drift, enforcement posture, and phase compatibility in detailed review evidence without consuming the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract across multiple renderers.

The implementation must expose canonical plan-review relationships with pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, and phase metadata in CLI, MCP, audit, close-error, and web-UI surfaces without duplicating status logic.
Ordinary ticket list output and persisted ticket events must remain unchanged while pin invalidity and enforcement-off drift are visibly distinguished as advisory.
Advanced documentation must cover plan-material-pin, phase metadata, rollout behavior, deletion repair, and validity profiles separately from basic user docs.
Audit rendering must call compute_validity and safely handle missing attestation, unexpected output, timeout, or exception without changing audit-trail never-raise behavior.
